publicationMeaning: status=publish is an editorial shortlist for the explicit staff review/publish flow. This manifest does not authorize automation to skip review, create ownership, mark communities verified or reuse historical counts as live.
method: Each selected code was fetched individually from the fixed official Cfx server endpoint and required gamename rdr3. English metadata was checked against community-authored descriptions and public rules where available. Public Discord invites were resolved to matching guild names. Logos and supported banners were fetched through the restricted image guard; known placeholders were visually rejected. Selection considers distinct roleplay styles, public community information and usable onboarding links rather than sorting solely by player count. No private Discord channels, server IP endpoints, player identifiers or accounts were collected.
limits: No firsthand in-game moderation or roleplay-quality audit was performed. Public server metadata and community descriptions remain self-reported.
A fresh count is a snapshot of the advertised Cfx server, not a promise of roleplay activity or capacity throughout the day. Refresh before publishing.
Region is not inferred from en-US. Unproven access gates remain unknown.
Framework detection uses known exposed resource names; it does not prove the server is an unmodified distribution.
Unsupported, expired and region-blocked artwork is omitted. Existing official source media is not an ownership verification.
